Source Information

Field Detail
Full name Integrated Postsecondary Education Data System (IPEDS)
Producer National Center for Education Statistics (NCES), U.S. Dept. of Education
Program page https://nces.ed.gov/ipeds/
Release schedule page https://nces.ed.gov/ipeds/survey-components/data-release-schedule
Coverage Institution, county (aggregated) · 2010–present · Annual
Surveys covered Institutional Characteristics (IC), Completions (C), Graduation Rates (GR)

NCES Collection Periods

IPEDS surveys are grouped into three reporting periods. The three surveys covered by this package fall in the first two periods:

Period Surveys in this package Typical release
Fall IC, Completions (C) ~August–September following the reference year
Winter Graduation Rates (GR) ~September–December following the reference year

NCES releases provisional data first; final (revised) data follows approximately one year later. Our pipeline picks up final data where available and falls back to provisional for the most recent vintage.

“Collection year” maps to the year column in package output as the second year of the academic year (e.g., 2022–23 collection = year = 2023).

Processed Years Log

Tracks which reference years have been written to S3. write_ipeds_all() returns a manifest data frame describing what it wrote – capture it to fill this in:

m <- write_ipeds_all(years = 2024)

The three S3 layers are data_raw/survey={survey}/year={year}/, data_institution/survey={survey}/year={year}/, and data_county/year={year}/.
